title: The corner lot went from bare dirt to a public garden in one season

photos.alt: A bare dirt lot behind a chain-link fence, under an open sky.
photos.caption: The lot sat empty behind its fence for six years after the hardware store on the corner closed.

photos.alt: A tall red construction crane rises above site fencing and a stack of pallets, photographed from ground level looking up.
photos.caption: Site fencing went up in March; the crane worked through most of April.

photos.alt: A green lawn with three planted beds, a wooden bench and a gravel path leading toward the camera.
photos.caption: By July, three planted beds and a bench had replaced the bare dirt.
